meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把任务拆成极小步骤逐步执行,每一步都要记录可观察的证据,并在清单里实时更新进度;遇到上下文被压缩时会先恢复目标与记录再继续,必要时还会派出多个子代理并行推进。
howto.when: 当你说出 “ulw-loop” 等关键词,或要求做证据导向的交付、手动质检时,Claude 会进入该流程。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 处理:把项目从 0 做到可演示版本。
say.note: Claude 会先建立目标清单,再逐步执行并记录证据。

say.text: 启动 ulw,把任务拆成小步,每步都要有可核对的证据。
say.note: 进入目标循环,逐步更新进度并记录证据。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 做长期交付,分阶段推进,定期暂停让我验收。
say.note: 保持清单更新,必要时派出子代理并行干活。

howto.what_en: Claude splits the goal into tiny steps, recording observable evidence for each and updating a live checklist. On context loss it restores goals and ledger first; it may spawn parallel subagents and, in team mode, use separate worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions "ulw-loop" etc., or asks for evidence-led work, manual QA.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to handle: take the project from scratch to a demoable version.
say_en.note: Creates goals/checklist, executes steps with evidence.

say_en.text: Start ulw: split the task into small steps, each with checkable evidence.
say_en.note: Enters the loop, updates progress, records evidence.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop for long delivery, phase by phase, pausing for my review.
say_en.note: Keeps checklist; may spawn parallel subagents.
